Yes, this is exactly right. On the review step the title and description are both mine to change — I can type right over them — while the site name, its icon, and the picture stay as the app pulled them in. That split makes sense to me: the words are the part I'd want to make my own, and the rest is stuff the app is better off fetching automatically.

I made the title "My PARA reference" and it stuck on the saved card. That's the behavior I was hoping for. This one feels good.
